## Why This Is Asked

Tests on-device NLP design, privacy guarantees, and multilingual handling with code-switching in a beginner-friendly setting. Assesses ability to blend regex-based detection with a compact NER model and plan labeling, rollout, and evaluation.

## Key Concepts

- On-device inference with WebAssembly
- PII detection: regex patterns + lightweight NER
- Multilingual and code-switching resilience
- Privacy guarantees and staged rollout
- Evaluation metrics: precision/recall for redactions

## Code Example

```javascript
function redactPII(text) {
  const email = /\b[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}\b/g;
  const phone = /\b(\+?\d{1,3}[-.\s+]?)?(\(?\d{2,4}\)?[-.\s+]?\d{3,4}[-.\s+]?\d{3,4})\b/g;
  return text
    .replace(email, "[REDACTED_EMAIL]")
    .replace(phone, "[REDACTED_PHONE]");
}
```

## Follow-up Questions

- How would you extend to additional languages?
- How would you validate redaction quality without leaking data?

questions.explanation:
# Why This Is Asked
Tests on-device NLP design under tight resources, multilinguality, and privacy. Candidates must justify model choices, quantization, drift detection, and OTA rollout.

# Key Concepts
- On-device inference with resource constraints
- Multilingual encoders and lightweight NLU
- Model compression: distillation, quantization, pruning
- Drift detection and secure OTA updates
- Privacy-preserving embeddings and offline-first architecture

# Code Example
```javascript
// Pseudo on-device inference outline
function infer(uttTokens, model) {
  const emb = model.encode(uttTokens); // quantized
  const intent = model.classify(emb);
  const actions = model.extract(emb);
  return { intent, actions };
}
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you implement canary OTA rollout with rollback on device?
- How would you evaluate drift with extremely limited labeled data on-device?

## Why This Is Asked

Tests ability to design a low-latency, multilingual NLP system that fuses diverse data streams into actionable risk signals, with explainability, provenance, and robust drift handling — all critical in finance.

## Key Concepts

- Multimodal streaming NLP and low-latency fusion
- Hybrid detectors (fast lexical + encoder-based)
- Shared multilingual latent space and per-language calibration
- Explainability via cited sources and token attributions
- Data provenance, rollback, and drift monitoring

## Code Example

```python
def fuse_signals(keyword_score, embed_score, lambda_=0.5):
    return lambda_*keyword_score + (1-lambda_)*embed_score
```

## Follow-up Questions

- How would you evaluate per-language drift and trigger automated rollbacks?
- What metrics and rollback thresholds would you use during live rollout?
